---
title: 'Password-based Auth'
---

Users often expect to sign in to your site with a password.

## With email

### Enabling email and password-based authentication

Email authentication is enabled by default. You can configure whether users need to verify their email to sign in. On hosted projects confirm email is on by default.

### Signing in with an email and password

Call `signInWithPassword`. If the user has not confirmed their email, sign in fails with "Email not confirmed". Wrong passwords return "Invalid login credentials".

```js
// ## this is not a heading
const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })
```

## Resetting a password

Use `resetPasswordForEmail` to send a reset link.
